title: Our logo
slide_intent: Teach designers to examine how the parts of a wordmark carry meaning. A viewer can recognize both the heavy capitals and the lightning-shaped opening between the last two letters.
strategic_value: Bolt can tie the promise of quick checkout to a feature within the name itself. The large specimen gives the distinctive cut enough room to be seen.
demonstration: The explanatory copy links the lightning detail with speed and the solid capitals with trustworthiness. A large blue wordmark fills the lower width of the white page.
practical_value: Use the enlarged mark to identify which shapes need to survive when the mark is reproduced elsewhere.
